mapper.select: select `like_user_id` likeUserId, `like_user_name` likeUserName, `like_user_avatar` likeUserAvatar, `activity_id` activityId, `user_id` userId, `ctime`, `type` from corgi_activity_like where activity_id = #{activityId} order by id desc limit #{start}, #{size}
select count(1) from corgi_activity_like where activity_id = #{activityId} and type = 'real'
select count(1) from corgi_activity_like l left join corgi_activity_creator a on l.activity_id = a.activity_id where l.ctime like concat(#{date}, '%') and a.category = #{category} and l.type = 'real'

select count(distinct l.like_user_id) from corgi_activity_like l left join corgi_activity_creator a on l.activity_id = a.activity_id where l.ctime like concat(#{date}, '%') and a.category = #{category} and l.type = 'real'

select `like_user_id` likeUserId, `like_user_name` likeUserName, `like_user_avatar` likeUserAvatar from corgi_activity_like l join corgi_user_follow f on f.follow_user_id = l.like_user_id and f.user_id = #{userId} and f.is_deleted = '0' where activity_id = #{activityId} order by l.id desc limit 3

from corgi_activity_like order by id desc limit #{start}, #{size}
select count(1) from corgi_activity_like l where l.user_id = #{userId} and l.type = 'real'
